title: Demographic-Reliant Algorithmic Fairness: Characterizing the Risks of Demographic Data Collection in the Pursuit of Fairness
reasoning: The paper is a qualitative analysis of the social and privacy risks associated with demographic data collection in algorithmic decision-making systems. While it discusses the 'ethics' of data governance and social justice, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks as a core component of its research.
